meta.name: BET Classics: The Jeffersons, Webster
meta.description:
We laughed ‘til we cried as our iconic Black entertainers took the sitcom world by storm, took off our hats as timeless movies finally featured people that looked like us, and variety shows showcased us to the world. Relive it all with BET Classics

Shows: The Jeffersons, Webster, The Best Of Flip Wilson, Soul!: The Complete Series, Sister, Sister
Available on: Pluto TV
